caption: Unpopular opinion: too many games copy Dark Souls. Agree or disagree? #hottake #soulslike #darksouls #sekiro #gaming #fyp

instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: too many games copy Dark Souls.

Dark Souls was special because it felt new. Now every action game has stamina bars and bonfires. Even Star Wars Jedi has meditation points that respawn enemies. Copying is not a design choice. FromSoftware itself changed the formula with Sekiro. The copycats should too. Agree?
